title: Seat holds on a fake clock: a test double that does not behave like a clock
name: Seat hold fake clock

questions.prompt: The ticketing team swapped real timers for the shared FakeClock in their hold-expiry tests, and now the expiry-order and reminder tests fail even though the production hold code works fine in staging. The hold and reminder code is correct: the fake is not faithful to how timers behave. Fix FakeClock so the tests pass.
